Trades

Filter the random card pool

Leave anything blank to ignore that filter. Saved filters apply to every click of the "Random card" button until you clear them.
Colors
Checking multiple WUBRG colors finds cards that contain ALL of those colors (may include extra colors too). Colorless and Multicolor are special modes - leave WUBRG unchecked when using them.

Add a card to your binder

Click a printing below to add it with quantity 1 (normal finish). You can adjust quantity, foil, and lock-from-trade on the card detail page after.

Your lists

Cards you OWN. Search to find a specific printing, or type / paste card names directly into the list below. To bulk-import a deck list (e.g. 1 Aetherize / 4 Lightning Bolt), paste it below and click Import deck list - leading counts and section headers get stripped automatically. Saved in your browser and synced to your account.
Price targets: add @<5 after a card to flag when it drops below $5 (buy target), or @>15 for above $15 (sell target). e.g. Lightning Bolt @<3 @>8. Targets show as 🎯 badges in the movers table.
Cards you WANT. Used to advertise what you're looking for when you share your binder, and to let other users see they have something you want when proposing trades. Same format as the Have list.

New deck

Name your deck, pick a box color, then paste a decklist or search to add cards. Counts like "4 Lightning Bolt" and printings like "Sol Ring (C21-263)" are supported. Saved in your browser only.

Add a local game store

Saved on this device and synced to your account. Use the store's own events page URL (its website, Facebook events, etc.) so the link drops you on a useful page.
